batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b JEC Franklin

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b RP Singh

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c JEC Franklin b SL Malinga

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b SL Malinga

batting.name: JEC Franklin
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b R Ashwin

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b DJ Bravo

balls.text: and he's overtaken Morkel now! Ashwin tries to slog the final ball over the leg side, he ends up mis-hitting it to Harbhajan at midwicket, sliced it high in the air
caught at point! Not a very good ball, length with some width outside off, it was a touch slower though, Jadeja cut it straight to Franklin
backs away and hits a good length ball towards mid-off, Malinga's bowling a splendid final over
in the blockhole outside off stump, the batsman tries to play on the off side but gets an inside edge on the leg side
another slower ball outside off stump, this time Jadeja is able to square drive through point
Malinga surprises the batsman with a slower ball on a good length outside off stump, Jadeja was beaten as he tried to steer to third man
bowled him! Morkel made room by moving way outside leg stump, RP Singh followed him with a yorker, the ball crashed into the pads and rebounded on to the stumps after Morkel missed the flick
the yorker this time, homing on to the boot, Jadeja misses the flick but gets a leg bye on the off side
and he's smashed his first ball for six! It was too short outside off stump and Jadeja slogged it off the front foot, hitting it over the long-on boundary

caught right on the edge of the long-on boundary! It was a length ball, there for hitting. Dhoni stayed in his crease, got under the ball and launched it flat. He just did not get enough elevation, which allowed Rohit to time his jump perfectly and prevent the ball from going for six
good length and cramping Morkel for room from over the wicket, Morkel goes back and swats to midwicket
in the blockhole around off stump, Dhoni swings it through midwicket
a full ball outside off stump, Morkel moves forward and drives through cover
Malinga replies with a fast and straight yorker and uproots leg stump. It tailed back into Bravo after initially swerving away from the right-hander. He just played around it
he's launched that! Bravo got under a full ball around off stump and blazed it flat over the infield at cover and into the gap on the boundary
the yorker goes wrong this time, ends up as a full toss on the pads, Bravo blitzes it to the deep backward square leg boundary, hit it very hard
that was a short ball at 143 kph, well directed too, Bravo flinched and ducked
in the blockhole right away, dug out on the leg side
in the blockhole once again, Dhoni runs after hitting it to long-on
driven to long-on along the ground this time
that's too short and outside off stump, Bravo simply heaves it over the long-on boundary with a flat bat, hit it off the front foot
in the blockhole this time, but Dhoni manages to dig it out towards long-on
a full toss on off and middle stump, Bravo drives down the ground towards long-on
good length but on the pads, played behind square
clubbed off the back foot to long off for a single
now he stays back and cuts the flat ball outside off stump with power through backward point
Dhoni charges, gets under the flighted ball and doesn't hold back at all, he swings with immense power, carting the ball miles over the straight boundary
quick, flat ball angling into middle stump, Dhoni stays back and drives towards cover, Harbhajan throws needlessly and concedes an overthrow
Dhoni steps out and hits the ball hard through midwicket
defended on the front foot towards the bowler
driven on the front foot through cover
Dhoni tries to play towards square leg but misses, the ball goes on the off side off the thigh and Bravo calls for the quick single
that's too short and at Franklin's pace that's asking for trouble, Dhoni pulls from outside off stump and hits it along the ground into the gap at deep midwicket
played off the pads to short fine leg
Dhoni drives his first ball through cover

RP's pulled off a screamer at point! He moved to his left and lunged quite a long way to intercept Raina's cut with both hands. The ball was of gentle pace and had generous width, Raina reached out for it and didn't cut it as hard as he would have liked. A half-hearted stroke against a seemingly harmless ball
a slower ball on a good length on leg and middle, played off the pads to short fine leg. The second time-out will be taken now
a full toss on off and middle, driven towards long-on
Raina stays in his crease and dabs a length ball from outside off towards third man
pushed towards extra cover for a single
slower ball outside off stump, Bravo waits for it and drives just a bit later, placing the ball behind point, RP Singh ran to his right from third man and dived but failed to prevent the four
length ball outside off, Bravo square drives with power but can't beat point
short of a length delivery which Raina clubs down the ground with a flat bat, the ball bounces just inside the boundary and goes over, RP wasn't quick enough from long-off
driven through backward point, Malinga is on the boundary and he runs to his right and attempts a pick up with one hand, he fumbles and allows the extra run
Raina tries to blast the ball through the off side but is beaten by one that slants away from him
played off the pads through midwicket
driven firmly towards long-off, where RP fields the ball on the bounce, odd choice of fielder for long off
another length ball, slower as well on leg and middle, Raina clears his front foot to create swinging space and swing he does, smashing the ball far over the deep midwicket boundary
a bit too short and Raina pulls towards deep midwicket, Malinga fumbles but the batsmen don't run a second
that's fired down leg side
played behind square for a single
driven with power towards wide long-on where Smith sprints to his right and dives full length to save the four
Harbhajan's not giving Raina any air at all, bowling it flat and quick and cramping the left-hander for room, Raina swings but mis-times through midwicket
pushed towards the leg side

Karthik thinks Bravo has edged the ball, but umpire Asad Rauf says not out. Bravo chased a very wide ball outside off and tried to drive, he lost grip on the bat, which ended up near square leg. The bowler might have escaped with a wide there
length ball, and Raina's dispatched it over wide long-on with a swing off the front foot, got under it and sent it sailing
this one cuts into the right-hander and hits the thigh, the ball goes towards the off side
good length outside off stump, Bravo comes forward but is beaten by the ball that straightens off the pitch
pushed towards extra cover for a single
Raina tries to drive a ball that is on a good length, he needed it to be fuller, he gets an outside edge that goes wide of the keeper, who is standing up to the stumps
Bravo plays the ball past his fellow West Indian towards long on
Bravo flicks the ball off his pads behind square, another economical over from Harbhajan
bowled flat and into the left-hander, Raina stays back and swats towards long-on
Bravo stays in his crease and flicks the ball past midwicket, who is the only fielder in the circle on the leg side
played from the crease towards midwicket
driven through cover for a single
Raina makes room and comes forward, Harbhajan slants the ball into the left-hander from round the wicket, bowled it quicker as well, Raina had to defend
he's beaten again outside off stump, there was lots of width and Bravo drove but couldn't get close enough to the ball
Bravo chases one that angles across him outside off stump, he tried to play a powerful square drive but missed
too full and straight as well, Bravo flicks through midwicket, giving the fielder at deep square leg some exercise, think it was Tendulkar
Raina moves slightly across to work the length ball in front of square leg
this one bounced alright, it bounced too high, that's a wide for height
the short ball and it doesn't bounce too high, Raina leans towards the off and pulls the ball along the ground through square leg
good length and straight, Raina pushes off the back foot with a straight bat, RP moves to his left to stop the ball
played from the crease towards midwicket
Raina pushes a flighted delivery that dips on him back to the bowler
fuller and straighter, Bravo drives to long-on off the front foot
this time the line is down leg side, Bravo had moved across to try and glance
defended on the leg side
Bravo pushes forward and outside off again but is beaten by another one that drifts across him
he beats Bravo with one that slides across the right-hander and bounces
Bravo tries to flick towards square leg but gets hit high on the thigh with one that shapes into him
that is some start from Bravo, an orthodox push through cover off the front foot, right out of the middle and the ball raced across this fast outfield

and now he's bowled Vijay! Terrific over from RP, this ball angled across the right-hander and pitched on a good length, Vijay came forward and aimed to heave the ball over midwicket, swinging across the line. The ball nipped back in and sped through the large gap between bat and pad and hit off stump
fuller length just outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point, three dots in a row. That's six runs off nine balls after the 24-run over from Munaf.
that ball lifts sharply from just short of a length, Vijay sways away from the line of the ball
Vijay tries to play the ball on the leg side but makes poor contact
this time he pushes towards mid-on and sprints, this time he does not stop and makes it
Vijay gets hit on the glove by a short of a length ball, it drops by his feet and he begins to run, he gets sent back
played off the back foot to point
Vijay moves forward and steers a length ball with superb timing to the wide third man boundary

Faf has been run out, Vijay's done him in. The ball was on a good length and straight, Vijay pushed it towards mid-on and called for the single and ran. Faf responded quickly and set off, and then Vijay stopped and went back. Faf had no hope unless the throw from mid-on missed, it did not. RP Singh was the fielder
good length and straight, played from the crease towards square leg
Munaf delivers a slower ball outside off stump, Vijay had backed away to make room and hit through the off side, he was beaten
the biggest of the lot, Vijay comes out of his crease and swings hard, smashing another length delivery far over the long-on boundary. That bounced off the first tier
he's laying into Munaf alright, this time the length ball disappears over deep midwicket after Vijay came on to the front foot and swung cleanly through the line
short of a length again and this time Vijay clubs the ball off the front foot over the bowler's head, Tendulkar chases but isn't quick enough
that's short and it sits up for Vijay, who swivels and pulls off the front foot, hitting it flat over the leaping Franklin on the boundary
that's quicker and much shorter, Vijay tries to hook the bouncer and misses, it was a touch down leg side
fuller ball and a touch slower, played off the front foot in front of square leg
Faf moves forward and across to another short of a length ball, he fends once again, playing the ball down towards the keeper's left
played towards midwicket from the crease
Vijay stays in his crease and steers a good length ball from off stump towards point
Faf comes out of his cease and is met with a short of a length ball aimed at his ribs, he fends it down close on the leg side and runs hard
Faf moves across his stumps to a straight length ball and flicks to midwicket, if he missed that there would have been a huge lbw appeal
good length and seaming away from the right-hander just outside off stump, Faf prods on the front foot and is beaten
the first ball is down leg side
defended on the off side
that is a shocking drop from RP Singh, the ball was on the pads and Faf glanced it straight to RP at short fine leg, straight to him. He barely had to move as the ball reached him at chin height
that's not that short at all but Vijay stays in his crease and swings the ball flat over midwicket, there's a fielder in the deep though
good length outside off, played off the front foot to point, where Rohit fields and hits the stumps direct at the bowler's end
Faf comes forward and tries to loft over mid-off, the length isn't full enough for that and he gets an outside edge towards third man
good length outside off, Faf comes forward and plays behind point
a bit too full on middle stump, Faf leans forward and pushes the ball with the angle into him through midwicket, Malinga gives chase and slides to prevent the four
RP pitches on a good length and gets the ball to bend back into Faf, who stays balanced and defends
width offered outside off by the line going across the right-hander, Vijay sits in his crease and uses the room to cut towards third man
Vijay comes forward and defends with bat close to pad

how did that not crash into the stumps? RP pitched the ball on a good length after slanting it across the right-hander from over the wicket, Vijay tried to defend from the crease but the ball jagged back into him and cut him in half, it passed over middle stump

flashy, flashy. Vijay tries to cut a good length ball that is too close to off stump, his footwork was stationary as well, the inside edge rockets past the stumps and beats the keeper diving to his left
good length on a wicket to wicket line, nudged from the crease towards square leg
played off the front foot to square leg
whoops, Vijay came down the track and hoicked, trying to hit towards long-on, he got an inside edge that went along the ground to deep midwicket
flight once again outside off, defended on the front foot
once again Vijay moves forward to drive a flighted ball, this time he plays it to cover
tossed up outside off stump, there's width for the right-hander and Vijay leans forward and caresses the drive through cover, a fluent start

he's done it! Would you believe it, Smith's blazed the final ball hard and flat, and even Faf cannot run quickly enough to his right to prevent the boundary. It was a length ball and Smith waited in his crease for it. An epic, hair-raising finish at the Wankhede and the stadium erupts
Smith is on f i r e. Hilfenhaus misses the yorker again, it's another full toss, Smith waits in his crease and blitzes it over the bowler's head
Smith keeps the game alive by clubbing a full toss flat over the long-on boundary, immense power, Hilfenhaus was going for the yorker but missed his length
a slower ball on a good length outside off, played to cover for a quick single

middle stump has been flattened and Smith watches helplessly from the non-striker's end. It was an accurate yorker from Hilfenhaus, Malinga cleared his front foot and slogged, he should have been looking to give Smith the strike instead
in the blockhole outside off, driven to long-off, it's Faf there and absolutely no chance to get Smith back on strike
well he's out now! Harbhajan Singh got a full toss, a low one outside off, but he could only swat it flat to Saha the substitute on the long-on boundary
a full ball on the pads, Smith flicks but only to short fine leg
that's huge! Smith stayed in his crease, got under a full ball and hammered it over long-on for a tremendous six

Faf's on fire in the field! He's run out Peterson and it's Chennai's game now. Bravo pitched in the blockhole outside off, well inside the tram line this time, Peterson dug it out towards mid-off and ran. Faf sprinted to the ball from the extra cover region, collected and threw at one stump while on the move. He hit. Peterson was not even in the frame.
full ball in the blockhole but wide outside off, it was just inside the tram line but the umpire calls it wide, tight tight call
the slower ball outside off stump, Peterson swings far too early and is beaten
in the blockhole, dug out towards midwicket for a single

this is probably a game-changing over. Rohit backed away towards leg to hit through the off side, Jadeja fired the ball in flat, quick and on a great length. Rohit was beaten and leg stump landed in Dhoni's gloves. The $2 million man earning his wages.
played off the back foot towards long on
Jadeja bowls a quick ball and hits the pads, a gem of an over so far for Chennai
bowled him! Chennai are clawing back into this game. Rayudu got down on one knee and slogged across the line, Jadeja skidded the ball through and hit middle stump
Rayudu reaches out for the ball outside off and mis-times it back to the bowler
angled into the right-hander from round the wicket, played from the crease towards mid-on

bowled him! Karthik moved a long way across his stumps to flick a full ball behind square. Fine leg was in the circle so Karthik exposed middle and leg stump to try and get a third boundary in the over. He missed and Bravo hit middle and leg
superb shot! He steps out this time, driving a short of a length ball on the up and past the diving fielder at cover
short and wide outside off stump, Karthik gets under the ball and slashes it over point for a pressure-relieving boundary
in the blockhole, driven to long on for a single
Karthik steps out of his crease and plays the ball off his pads to midwicket
good length just outside off, driven on the front foot to long-off
Karthik sweeps towards long leg

Faf has pulled off a stunning catch at cover, and it needed something as special as that to end this partnership. Tendulkar backed away towards leg and hit the ball inside out, smashing it flat over cover. Faf jumped, stuck out his right hand and plucked the ball out of the air. The ball was nearly past him when he caught that, arching his back
Rohit steps out of his crease and has to drive the ball from the blockhole towards cover
driven back to the bowler
Tendulkar moves across his stumps to pull on one knee and doesn't make proper contact, gets hit on the pad
Rohit gets down on one knee and sweeps to deep square leg
short ball, Tendulkar frees his arms and biffs it flat over the bowler with a flat bat, long-off has no chance, Mumbai are like a runaway train at the moment
Tendulkar's turn to go inside out, skipping down and outside leg to launch the ball into the gap on the extra cover boundary. One-bounce four
he makes room once again and cuts the ball from middle stump towards deep cover
Rohit moves towards leg to loft inside out and he places the ball into the gap on the extra cover boundary
Tendulkar steps out, makes room and lofts the ball flat to long-on, where it reaches Bravo on the first bounce
driven off the back foot towards long-on, that's Rohit's fifty as well, off 37 balls
dabbed on the off side for an easy single
Tendulkar charges, Jadeja fires it in quick and straight, Tendulkar hits towards long-on
nudged off the pads in front of square
flicked off the pads through square
now he leans forward and chips the ball inside out over extra cover, giving Bravo at long-off a lot of running to do. Tendulkar should bat like this every innings.
Tendulkar moves towards leg to make room, comes forward, and drives inside out through cover to bring up the 100 stand
played off the back foot to cover
Tendulkar charges now and hits the ball flat towards wide long-on, falls short of the fielder
short ball and it's pulled to deep midwicket
terrific strike! Rohit charges a flighted delivery, gets to the pitch of it, and lofts the ball straight over the bowler's head and far over the sight screen
good length and straight, Rohit stays in his crease and pushes back to the bowler
played off the back foot to cover
played from the crease in front of square
Rohit backs away towards leg and cuts the ball late, from off stump almost, behind point and into the gap on the third man boundary
goes back and across to nudge the ball through square leg
bowled flat from round the wicket, played off the back foot through midwicket
worked off the pads in front of square leg
pushed off the front foot towards long-on, the fielder from midwicket cuts it off
that's bowled very wide down leg side from round the wicket
this shot is more forceful, Tendulkar drove the length ball outside off hard and flat over extra cover, Morkel's copped a hiding. That brought up Tendulkar's 50 by the way
pure timing, Tendulkar moves across his stumps to get inside the line of a ball on his pads, and helps it along, lofting it over fine leg, just used the bowler's pace
a better length outside off stump, Tendulkar slashes outside off but is beaten
short ball with width outside off, Tendulkar slaps it over the infield at cover, the fielder in the circle jumped but it was too high for him
Tendulkar's standing outside leg stump, ready to make room, Albie bowls a short delivery and slants it into the right-hander, Tendulkar sways back and avoids the ball
full ball on middle stump, Tendulkar made room and drove firmly, but can't beat mid-off
full ball on middle stump, flicked through square leg, Jakati's first over is a tight one
played off the front foot through midwicket
pulled off the back foot through midwicket
Tendulkar waited very late and then dabbed the ball off the face of the bat, Dhoni stuck out his right leg and deflected the ball to short third man, like a hockey goalkeeper
played through midwicket this time on the front foot
Rohit tries to play towards midwicket but gets an inside edge on to his shoe
makes room by moving towards leg and drives a good length ball to mid-on
Tendulkar charges and lofts the ball high towards long-off, he's not timed it perfectly but still well enough for a one-bounce four

that's in the air, third man comes running in, but he does not get to it, so that's a drop. Ashwin did not start quickly enough towards the ball and in the end he had to lunge for the ball and it dropped just short. Rohit had tried to blast over cover but got a thick outside edge
good length just outside off, Tendulkar plays it late, opening the face and dabbing towards third man
Sharma hits the ball from the crease towards cover point and runs, the fielder is on the edge of the circle
short of a length but the line is much too wide outside off, Sharma does not chase it
length ball with width outside off stump, Tendulkar's stance is on leg and he cuts to the fielder at deep point
goes back and dabs the ball behind point
moves forward and flicks the ball off the pads through midwicket
cut off the back foot through point
driven from the crease to long-on
played off the front foot on the leg side, Ashwin moves to his right to field
played off the front foot towards long-on
good length and straight, Rohit plays with a straight bat towards the bowler
cramped for room this time and he dabs the ball to du Plessis at point
Rohit comes forward, makes room and cuts a short of a length ball with enviable timing behind point, it's too quick for the fielder at third man
played off the pads towards fine leg
Rohit moves forward and towards the off to steer a short of a length ball towards third man
Bravo's first ball is terrible, short and wide outside off, Rohit reaches out and cuts in the air but past the diving fielder at point
no finger tips on this one, Tendulkar backed away again and hit the ball flatter and harder past the bowler, Ashwin didn't have time to try
Tendulkar backed away and slapped the ball hard and flat over the bowler's head, Ashwin jumped up and got finger tips on it, an extremely difficult chance. Vijay chases the ball and prevents the four
played off the pads through square leg, Ashwin bowled that quicker
Sharma leans forward and defends on the leg side
nudged off the front foot on the leg side
full ball on middle stump, driven towards long-on

that is some shot! Rohit came forward, moved across his stumps, picked up a length ball and swung hard across the line, there was a fearful sound as the ball met bat, moments later it was in the stands beyond deep midwicket
good length around off stump, Tendulkar moves forward and towards the ball to square drive to deep point
there's more width outside off and Rohit cuts to third man
he swings hard again, trying to launch a good length delivery from around off stump down the ground, he gets beaten by the movement away from him
he steps out this time and lofts a good length ball over mid-off, not timed well and it just cleared the fielder, but once it pitched it raced to the boundary
Rohit tries to drive a good length ball on the up but gets a thick outside edge towards point, along the ground though
good length and straight, Tendulkar flicks to midwicket
a length ball with lots of width outside off, Tendulkar reaches for it and lofts the slower ball over cover and to the boundary
loud appeal for lbw as Tendulkar moves towards the off to try and paddle the ball towards fine leg, he was hit on the pad outside the line of off stump
now he's charged Morkel, and slapped the length ball hard in front of point, there was a fielder close on the off side but it was to Bravo's left and hit very hard
another length ball, this time around off stump, driven on the up to the fielder on the edge of the circle at cover
length ball on the pads, Tendulkar jumps back and flicks the ball fluently through square leg, typical Tendulkar
a bit too full and straight this time, Rohit leans across his stumps and flicks towards deep midwicket
more movement away from Rohit, who lets it go through to Dhoni

first runs off Hilfenhaus and it's via an outside edge between first slip and gully to the third man boundary, Rohit tried to play the off drive but got an outside edge to a good length ball that shaped away from the right-hander
good length outside off, played off the front foot to mid-off, a ninth dot
caught at mid-on, Franklin was under pressure and he's cracked. After seven dots against Hilfenhaus, he swats a good length ball straight to Vijay. A limp shot
good length and straight, Franklin plays it back to the bowler, seventh dot for Hilfenhaus
finally Franklin scores a run, pulling a short of a length ball through square leg
punched off the back foot towards mid-off
too full on the pads, Tendulkar manages to glance the ball to the fine leg boundary, he's actually inside-edged it between his legs! He was late on the shot
driven flat and in the air but just short of the fielder at mid-off, Jakati came forward but couldn't reach it
finally Mumbai get going, Tendulkar staying in his crease and flicking a length ball between midwicket and mid-on
good length outside off, Tendulkar mis-times the cut towards cover
Hilfenhaus starts the defence with a maiden, Franklin tries to cut the last ball but bottom-edges it close to his stumps
the sharp bouncer from Hilfenhaus, Franklin sways out of the line
fuller ball outside off, Franklin moves forward and drives fluently but doesn't beat the man at short cover, four dots in a row now
width outside off stump, Franklin plays off the front foot towards extra cover
Franklin tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pad, Hilfenhaus appeals for lbw but that was missing leg
a fullish length angling across Franklin before bending back a little, Franklin drives to the bowler
